note: Every language the game knows. A new language is added with DATA only: (1) an entry here (BCP 47 tag, own name, direction, script, fallback, voice), (2) its texts - inside records or as string files in content/src/l10n/<tag>/, (3) its voice clips (tools/gen_voice.py --lang <tag>). Nothing in the app is hard-coded to English or French. status: active = offered to children on the live site; in-review = offered on the preview site only (texts are drafts awaiting a fluent reviewer); planned = not offered; test-only = never shipped, used by the test suite only.

Arab.note: Arabic, Urdu, Persian: right-to-left, joined letters - never letter-space, never fake bold.

voice.note: Default English voice (Mia). Stage 2 replaces it after the clarity test.

locales.name: Français
locales.note: Pilot French drafts await a fluent French reviewer.
